description: This file defines the EmployeeDirectoryService class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides a service layer for accessing the EmployeeDirectoryDao data access object, including a method to retrieve or instantiate the DAO.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryService
classes.description: A service class providing access to the EmployeeDirectoryDao, with lazy initialization.

methods.name: getEmployeeDirectoryDao
methods.description: Returns the existing EmployeeDirectoryDao instance or creates a new one if it doesn't exist.
